// mtglab-ui-scribe: The API with the scribe wired in (ADR 42), which is what draws a
board in the Coliseum. `mtglab-ui` plays a match through Forge's
own `sim` and narrates from the log: an account and no
battlefield. This entry points MTGLAB_SCRIBE_CLASSES at the
checkout's compiled classes, so a local match reports zones,
tier3.Settings.Scribed is false and this behaves exactly like
`mtglab-ui`, which is the degrade the worker image makes too.
configurations.name: mtglab-ui-scribe

// web-dev: Vite with HMR, for visual work. `vite.config.ts` proxies /api to
127.0.0.1:8765, so `mtglab-ui` has to be running alongside it — this
entry serves the frontend, that one serves the data.
The other four entries serve the *committed* bundle out of
`web_dist`, so a change under `web/src` is invisible to
them until `npm --prefix web run build`. That is the right thing for
testing what ships and the wrong thing for iterating on a colour.
configurations.name: web-dev
